title: 橋梁伸縮縫安裝與更換
summary: 從溫度、乾縮、潛變與活載造成的梁端位移出發，決定伸縮縫型式與間隙數，檢核中梁輪載衝擊與疲勞，再處理錨碇箱與後澆混凝土、安裝溫度預設、通車條件下的分幅更換、出廠疲勞與防水試驗、現場間隙—溫度量測，最後以止水排水維護與生命週期更換策略交接，並以新 Tappan Zee 橋的 LR18 模組式伸縮縫、Øresund 橋的旋轉橫梁伸縮縫更換與漢堡 Köhlbrand 橋伸縮縫翻修為案例。
summaryEn: Starting from girder-end movements due to temperature, shrinkage, creep and live load, choose the joint type and number of gaps and check centre-beam wheel impact and fatigue, then handle anchorage boxes and blockout concrete, temperature presetting at installation, staged replacement under traffic, factory fatigue and watertightness tests and field gap–temperature measurements, and finally hand over with seal and drainage maintenance and a life-cycle replacement strategy, using the LR18 modular joints of the new Tappan Zee crossing, the swivel-joist joint replacement on the Øresund Bridge and the joint rehabilitation of Hamburg's Köhlbrand Bridge as cases.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 選型練習：一座鋼橋伸縮長度 480 m，α = 12×10⁻⁶ /°C，結構溫度範圍 −5 至 +55°C（ΔT = 60°C）：溫度位移 12×10⁻⁶×480,000×60 ≈ 346 mm；加上活載轉角與煞車往復 ±20 mm 共 40 mm，合計約 386 mm。若模組式每間隙 80 mm，需 386/80 ≈ 4.8，取 5 個間隙（400 mm），中位開口 200 mm（每間隙 40 mm），參考溫度 25°C。安裝時結構溫度 35°C，梁較中位長 12×10⁻⁶×480,000×10 ≈ 58 mm，預設總開口 200 − 58 ≈ 142 mm，平均每間隙約 28.5 mm。若耐震要求另需容納 150 mm 地震位移，總需求約 536 mm，需 536/80 ≈ 6.7，取 7 個間隙；或改採在地震時允許犧牲、事後快速更換的設計，兩者須與業主的震後通行目標一起比較。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際橋梁的設計。
workedExample.textEn: Selection exercise: a steel bridge has a 480 m expansion length, α = 12×10⁻⁶ /°C and a structure temperature range of −5 to +55°C (ΔT = 60°C), so thermal movement is 12×10⁻⁶×480,000×60 ≈ 346 mm; adding ±20 mm, 40 mm in all, for live-load rotation and braking gives about 386 mm. At 80 mm per modular gap, 386/80 ≈ 4.8, so 5 gaps (400 mm) with a mid opening of 200 mm (40 mm per gap) at a 25°C reference. Installed at a structure temperature of 35°C, the girder is 12×10⁻⁶×480,000×10 ≈ 58 mm longer than at mid, so the preset total opening is 200 − 58 ≈ 142 mm, about 28.5 mm per gap. If seismic design also requires 150 mm of earthquake displacement, the demand becomes about 536 mm, needing 536/80 ≈ 6.7, so 7 gaps; alternatively a design that may be sacrificed in an earthquake and quickly replaced afterwards can be compared, together with the owner's post-earthquake access objective. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real bridge.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「梁端位移來源與伸縮量需求」與「輪載衝擊、煞車力與疲勞」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Sources of girder-end movement and the required range" and "Wheel impact, braking force and fatigue": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 梁端位移來源與伸縮量需求：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Sources of girder-end movement and the required range: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「設計伸縮量」如何影響橋梁伸縮縫安裝與更換的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Design movement range” governs force, deformation or durability in “Bridge expansion-joint installation and replacement”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 伸縮縫位於兩段結構之間，必須容納梁端的縱向伸縮、轉角與少量橫向及豎向位移，同時讓車輪平順通過、阻止雨水與鹽分落到支承與墩帽上。梁端位移的主要來源是溫度變化，混凝土橋另有乾縮與潛變造成的單向縮短，長跨橋還有活載、風與煞車造成的往復位移，耐震設計可能再加上地震位移。伸縮量由固定點到伸縮縫之間的伸縮長度決定，所以支承配置與固定點位置改變，伸縮縫需求也隨之改變。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「設計伸縮量」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An expansion joint sits between two structural parts and must accommodate longitudinal movement, rotation and some transverse and vertical displacement of the girder ends, while letting wheels pass smoothly and keeping rain and salt off bearings and pier caps. The main source of movement is temperature; concrete bridges add one-way shortening from shrinkage and creep, long spans add cyclic movements from live load, wind and braking, and seismic design may add earthquake displacement. The movement is governed by the expansion length between the fixed point and the joint, so changing the bearing layout or fixed point changes the joint demand too. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Design movement range” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For a prestressed concrete bridge with an expansion length L = 300 m: temperature ΔL = αLΔT = 10×10⁻⁶×300,000×50 = 150 mm; remaining shrinkage 200×10⁻⁶×300,000 = 60 mm; creep (5/35,000)×1.5×300,000 ≈ 64 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「伸縮縫只需要依照溫度變化計算伸縮量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Joint movement only needs to be calculated from temperature change." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「設計伸縮量」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Design movement range”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 梁端位移來源與伸縮量需求：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Sources of girder-end movement and the required range: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「設計伸縮量」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Design movement range” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：預力混凝土橋伸縮長度 L = 300 m：溫度 ΔL = αLΔT = 10×10⁻⁶×300,000×50 = 150 mm；殘餘乾縮 200×10⁻⁶×300,000 = 60 mm；潛變 (5/35,000)×1.5×300,000 ≈ 64 mm。合計 150 + 60 + 64 ≈ 274 mm，若模組式每間隙 80 mm，需 274/80 ≈ 3.4，取 4 個間隙（320 mm）。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a prestressed concrete bridge with an expansion length L = 300 m: temperature ΔL = αLΔT = 10×10⁻⁶×300,000×50 = 150 mm; remaining shrinkage 200×10⁻⁶×300,000 = 60 mm; creep (5/35,000)×1.5×300,000 ≈ 64 mm. The total, 150 + 60 + 64 ≈ 274 mm, at 80 mm per modular gap needs 274/80 ≈ 3.4, so 4 gaps (320 mm). Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：設計時列出位移計算表：伸縮長度、溫度範圍（依規範的有效溫度）、乾縮潛變的殘餘比例、活載與煞車位移、地震位移，並分開標示可逆與單向分量；與支承設計者核對固定點、活動支承行程與伸縮縫需求一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: At design stage tabulate movements: expansion length, temperature range from the code's effective bridge temperature, remaining proportion of shrinkage and creep, live-load and braking movements and seismic displacement, marking reversible and one-way components separately; check with the bearing designer that the fixed point, bearing travel and joint demand are consistent.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: For a prestressed concrete bridge with an expansion length L = 300 m: temperature ΔL = αLΔT = 10×10⁻⁶×300,000×50 = 150 mm; remaining shrinkage 200×10⁻⁶×300,000 = 60 mm; creep (5/35,000)×1.5×300,000 ≈ 64 mm. The total, 150 + 60 + 64 ≈ 274 mm, at 80 mm per modular gap needs 274/80 ≈ 3.4, so 4 gaps (320 mm). Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「梁端位移來源與伸縮量需求」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Sources of girder-end movement and the required range", which statement holds?
options: 後澆混凝土只要外觀硬化，就可以開放重車通行。
更換伸縮縫只是拆舊換新，與結構安全無關，可由鋪面工班自行處理。
預力混凝土橋伸縮長度 L = 300 m：溫度 ΔL = αLΔT = 10×10⁻⁶×300,000×50 = 150 mm。
optionsEn: Once blockout concrete looks hard, heavy trucks can be allowed back.
Replacing a joint is just swapping old for new, unrelated to structural safety, and can be left to the paving crew.
For a prestressed concrete bridge with an expansion length L = 300 m: temperature ΔL = αLΔT = 10×10⁻⁶×300,000×50 = 150 mm.
quiz.explanationEn: For a prestressed concrete bridge with an expansion length L = 300 m: temperature ΔL = αLΔT = 10×10⁻⁶×300,000×50 = 150 mm; remaining shrinkage 200×10⁻⁶×300,000 = 60 mm; creep (5/35,000)×1.5×300,000 ≈ 64 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 梁端位移來源與伸縮量需求：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Sources of girder-end movement and the required range: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「設計伸縮量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Design movement range” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 設計時列出位移計算表：伸縮長度、溫度範圍（依規範的有效溫度）、乾縮潛變的殘餘比例、活載與煞車位移、地震位移，並分開標示可逆與單向分量；與支承設計者核對固定點、活動支承行程與伸縮縫需求一致。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: At design stage tabulate movements: expansion length, temperature range from the code's effective bridge temperature, remaining proportion of shrinkage and creep, live-load and braking movements and seismic displacement, marking reversible and one-way components separately; check with the bearing designer that the fixed point, bearing travel and joint demand are consistent. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：伸縮縫規格須列出各方向設計位移、轉角、可逆與單向分量、地震設計策略（容納或可犧牲），以及安裝時的預設計算方法，並與支承規格一起審查。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The joint specification must list design movements in each direction, rotations, reversible and one-way components, the seismic strategy (accommodate or sacrificial) and the presetting method, and be reviewed together with the bearing specification.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只以溫度計算伸縮量，忽略混凝土橋多年的乾縮與潛變縮短，伸縮縫數年後在冬季拉開超過行程，止水帶撕裂、中梁脫出控制系統；地震位移未考慮時，伸縮縫在大地震中被擠壓破壞，造成橋面落差阻礙救災通行。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Sizing the joint for temperature alone, ignoring years of shrinkage and creep in a concrete bridge, lets it open beyond its range in winter after a few years, tearing seals and pulling centre beams out of their control system; ignoring seismic displacement lets the joint be crushed in a major earthquake, leaving a step in the deck that blocks emergency traffic. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 設計時列出位移計算表：伸縮長度、溫度範圍（依規範的有效溫度）、乾縮潛變的殘餘比例、活載與煞車位移、地震位移，並分開標示可逆與單向分量；與支承設計者核對固定點、活動支承行程與伸縮縫需求一致。
knowledge.textEn: At design stage tabulate movements: expansion length, temperature range from the code's effective bridge temperature, remaining proportion of shrinkage and creep, live-load and braking movements and seismic displacement, marking reversible and one-way components separately; check with the bearing designer that the fixed point, bearing travel and joint demand are consistent.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 伸縮縫規格須列出各方向設計位移、轉角、可逆與單向分量、地震設計策略（容納或可犧牲），以及安裝時的預設計算方法，並與支承規格一起審查。
knowledge.textEn: The joint specification must list design movements in each direction, rotations, reversible and one-way components, the seismic strategy (accommodate or sacrificial) and the presetting method, and be reviewed together with the bearing specification.

quiz.question: 要驗證「梁端位移來源與伸縮量需求」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Sources of girder-end movement and the required range"?

optionsEn: At design stage tabulate movements: expansion length, temperature range from the code's effective bridge temperature, remaining proportion of shrinkage and creep, live-load and braking movements and seismic displacement, marking reversible and one-way components separately.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Joint gaps change every day, so measuring them is meaningless.
quiz.explanation: 設計時列出位移計算表：伸縮長度、溫度範圍（依規範的有效溫度）、乾縮潛變的殘餘比例、活載與煞車位移、地震位移，並分開標示可逆與單向分量；與支承設計者核對固定點、活動支承行程與伸縮縫需求一致。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: At design stage tabulate movements: expansion length, temperature range from the code's effective bridge temperature, remaining proportion of shrinkage and creep, live-load and braking movements and seismic displacement, marking reversible and one-way components separately; check with the bearing designer that the fixed point, bearing travel and joint demand are consistent. steps.title: 梁端位移來源與伸縮量需求：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Sources of girder-end movement and the required range: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「設計伸縮量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Design movement range” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只以溫度計算伸縮量，忽略混凝土橋多年的乾縮與潛變縮短，伸縮縫數年後在冬季拉開超過行程，止水帶撕裂、中梁脫出控制系統；地震位移未考慮時，伸縮縫在大地震中被擠壓破壞，造成橋面落差阻礙救災通行。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Sizing the joint for temperature alone, ignoring years of shrinkage and creep in a concrete bridge, lets it open beyond its range in winter after a few years, tearing seals and pulling centre beams out of their control system; ignoring seismic displacement lets the joint be crushed in a major earthquake, leaving a step in the deck that blocks emergency traffic. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：伸縮量由固定點到伸縮縫之間的伸縮長度決定，所以支承配置與固定點位置改變，伸縮縫需求也隨之改變。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The movement is governed by the expansion length between the fixed point and the joint, so changing the bearing layout or fixed point changes the joint demand too.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「伸縮縫只需要依照溫度變化計算伸縮量。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Joint movement only needs to be calculated from temperature change." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若只以溫度計算伸縮量，忽略混凝土橋多年的乾縮與潛變縮短，伸縮縫數年後在冬季拉開超過行程，止水帶撕裂、中梁脫出控制系統；地震位移未考慮時，伸縮縫在大地震中被擠壓破壞，造成橋面落差阻礙救災通行。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「梁端位移來源與伸縮量需求」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Sources of girder-end movement and the required range" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。

Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 輪載衝擊、煞車力與疲勞：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Wheel impact, braking force and fatigue: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「中梁輪載衝擊」如何影響橋梁伸縮縫安裝與更換的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Centre-beam wheel impact” governs force, deformation or durability in “Bridge expansion-joint installation and replacement”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 伸縮縫直接承受車輪衝擊：輪胎從橋面滾到鋼梁再滾回橋面，路面的高低差與間隙造成衝擊，動態放大比一般橋面更大；車輛煞車與加速又在縫面上施加水平力。模組式伸縮縫的中梁像一根多跨連續梁，擱在間距約一公尺多的支撐梁上，每一次車輪通過都在中梁與支撐梁的焊接或連接處產生應力循環，所以疲勞是模組式伸縮縫最主要的結構問題，美國 NCHRP 的研究與 AASHTO 規範都要求以疲勞試驗驗證。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「中梁輪載衝擊」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Expansion joints take wheel impact directly: as a tyre rolls from the deck onto steel beams and back, steps and gaps cause impact with larger dynamic amplification than elsewhere on the deck, and braking and acceleration apply horizontal forces at the surface. In a modular joint the centre beam acts as a multi-span continuous beam on support bars spaced a little over a metre apart, and every wheel passage cycles stress at the centre-beam-to-support-bar weld or connection, so fatigue is the main structural issue for modular joints; NCHRP research and AASHTO provisions call for verification by fatigue testing. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Centre-beam wheel impact” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：輪載 75 kN 乘動態放大 1.3 為 97.5 kN；中梁支撐間距 s = 1.2 m，以連續梁近似 M ≈ P·s/6 = 97.5×1.2/6 ≈ 19.5 kN·m；中梁斷面模數 2.0×10⁵ mm³ 時 σ ≈ 19.5×10⁶/2.0×10⁵ ≈ 97.5 MPa，每次重車輪通過形成一次接近此值的應力循環。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A 75 kN wheel times a 1.3 dynamic factor gives 97.5 kN; with centre-beam supports at s = 1.2 m and a continuous-beam approximation M ≈ P·s/6 = 97.5×1.2/6 ≈ 19.5 kN·m; for a section modulus of 2.0×10⁵ mm³, σ ≈ 19.5×10⁶/2.0×10⁵ ≈ 97.5 MPa, a stress cycle of about this size at every heavy wheel.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「伸縮縫只是鋪面上的蓋板，不需要做疲勞設計。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An expansion joint is just a cover plate in the pavement and needs no fatigue design." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「中梁輪載衝擊」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Centre-beam wheel impact”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 輪載衝擊、煞車力與疲勞：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Wheel impact, braking force and fatigue: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「中梁輪載衝擊」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Centre-beam wheel impact” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：輪載 75 kN 乘動態放大 1.3 為 97.5 kN；中梁支撐間距 s = 1.2 m，以連續梁近似 M ≈ P·s/6 = 97.5×1.2/6 ≈ 19.5 kN·m；中梁斷面模數 2.0×10⁵ mm³ 時 σ ≈ 19.5×10⁶/2.0×10⁵ ≈ 97.5 MPa，每次重車輪通過形成一次接近此值的應力循環。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A 75 kN wheel times a 1.3 dynamic factor gives 97.5 kN; with centre-beam supports at s = 1.2 m and a continuous-beam approximation M ≈ P·s/6 = 97.5×1.2/6 ≈ 19.5 kN·m; for a section modulus of 2.0×10⁵ mm³, σ ≈ 19.5×10⁶/2.0×10⁵ ≈ 97.5 MPa, a stress cycle of about this size at every heavy wheel. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：製造商須提交依規範或認證指引完成的疲勞試驗報告（中梁、支撐梁與其連接），以及在設計交通量下的疲勞檢核；安裝後以平整度量測確認縫面與鋪面高差在允差內，因為高差會直接放大衝擊。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: The manufacturer must submit fatigue test reports to the code or approval guideline for centre beams, support bars and their connections, plus a fatigue check for the design traffic; after installation, measure flushness to confirm the step between joint and pavement is within tolerance, since a step directly amplifies impact.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 輪載衝擊、煞車力與疲勞：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Wheel impact, braking force and fatigue: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「中梁輪載衝擊」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Centre-beam wheel impact” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 製造商須提交依規範或認證指引完成的疲勞試驗報告（中梁、支撐梁與其連接），以及在設計交通量下的疲勞檢核；安裝後以平整度量測確認縫面與鋪面高差在允差內，因為高差會直接放大衝擊。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: The manufacturer must submit fatigue test reports to the code or approval guideline for centre beams, support bars and their connections, plus a fatigue check for the design traffic; after installation, measure flushness to confirm the step between joint and pavement is within tolerance, since a step directly amplifies impact. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：採購規格要求依交通量分級的疲勞試驗與型式認證，並規定縫面與鋪面高差允差；重車比例高的路段應優先採用經試驗驗證的連接細部，並把伸縮縫列入每次例行檢查的必看項目。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Procurement should require fatigue testing and type approval graded by traffic, and a flushness tolerance between joint and pavement; routes with heavy truck traffic should favour connection details proven by testing, and joints are a mandatory item at every routine inspection.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：中梁與支撐梁的焊縫在重車反覆衝擊下疲勞斷裂，中梁局部鬆脫並發出撞擊聲，嚴重時中梁翹起成為行車危害；鋪面與縫面高差過大，衝擊加劇，使錨碇與後澆混凝土提早破壞。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: The weld between centre beam and support bar cracks by fatigue under repeated heavy impacts, the centre beam works loose and bangs, and in severe cases lifts up as a traffic hazard; a large step between pavement and joint intensifies impact and destroys anchorages and blockout concrete early. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.title: 輪載衝擊、煞車力與疲勞：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「中梁輪載衝擊」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Centre-beam wheel impact” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 中梁與支撐梁的焊縫在重車反覆衝擊下疲勞斷裂，中梁局部鬆脫並發出撞擊聲，嚴重時中梁翹起成為行車危害；鋪面與縫面高差過大，衝擊加劇，使錨碇與後澆混凝土提早破壞。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: The weld between centre beam and support bar cracks by fatigue under repeated heavy impacts, the centre beam works loose and bangs, and in severe cases lifts up as a traffic hazard; a large step between pavement and joint intensifies impact and destroys anchorages and blockout concrete early. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：模組式伸縮縫的中梁像一根多跨連續梁，擱在間距約一公尺多的支撐梁上，每一次車輪通過都在中梁與支撐梁的焊接或連接處產生應力循環，所以疲勞是模組式伸縮縫最主要的結構問題，美國 NCHRP 的研究與 AASHTO 規範都要求以疲勞試驗驗證。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: In a modular joint the centre beam acts as a multi-span continuous beam on support bars spaced a little over a metre apart, and every wheel passage cycles stress at the centre-beam-to-support-bar weld or connection, so fatigue is the main structural issue for modular joints; NCHRP research and AASHTO provisions call for verification by fatigue testing.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「伸縮縫只是鋪面上的蓋板，不需要做疲勞設計。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An expansion joint is just a cover plate in the pavement and needs no fatigue design." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部

stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Joint types and modular construction" and "Anchorage details and blockout concrete curing": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 伸縮縫型式與模組式構造：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Joint types and modular construction: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「模組式中梁與支撐梁」如何影響橋梁伸縮縫安裝與更換的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Modular centre beams and support bars” governs force, deformation or durability in “Bridge expansion-joint installation and replacement”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 小位移可用壓縮密封縫或條形止水縫，中等位移可用梳齒板，大位移則用模組式伸縮縫：多根中梁把總位移分成數個間隙，每個間隙以橡膠止水帶封閉，下方支撐梁擱在錨碇箱內並可滑動，彈性控制系統讓各間隙平均開合。另一種大位移形式是旋轉橫梁（swivel joist）伸縮縫，支撐橫梁可旋轉，能同時容納縱向、橫向與轉角位移。Øresund 橋的 DS15 旋轉橫梁伸縮縫以 15 個型材容納約 1,500 mm 位移，新 Tappan Zee 橋最大的 LR18 模組式伸縮縫有 18 個間隙、位移可達約 1.4 m。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「模組式中梁與支撐梁」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Small movements use compression seals or strip seals, medium movements finger plates, and large movements modular joints: several centre beams divide the total movement into gaps sealed by elastomeric profiles, support bars below slide within anchorage boxes, and an elastic control system keeps the gaps opening evenly. Another large-movement form is the swivel-joist joint, whose support joists can rotate, accommodating longitudinal, transverse and rotational movement together. The Øresund Bridge's DS15 swivel-joist joint takes about 1,500 mm with 15 profiles, and the largest LR18 modular joints on the new Tappan Zee crossing have 18 gaps and movements up to about 1.4 m. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Modular centre beams and support bars” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：每間隙平均位移 = 總位移/間隙數。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Average movement per gap = total movement/number of gaps.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「模組式伸縮縫的間隙會自然平均開合，不需要控制系統。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Modular joint gaps open evenly by themselves without a control system." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「模組式中梁與支撐梁」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Modular centre beams and support bars”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 伸縮縫型式與模組式構造：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Joint types and modular construction: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「模組式中梁與支撐梁」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Modular centre beams and support bars” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：每間隙平均位移 = 總位移/間隙數。Tappan Zee LR18：1,400/18 ≈ 78 mm（54 in/18 = 3 in）；Øresund DS15：1,500/15 = 100 mm；Köhlbrand LR8 760 mm、LR12 1,140 mm，皆約 95 mm/間隙。控制系統失效使一間隙承擔兩倍位移時，該間隙需約 156 至 200 mm，超過止水帶容許而撕裂。數值依公開資料換算，失效情境為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Average movement per gap = total movement/number of gaps. Tappan Zee LR18: 1,400/18 ≈ 78 mm (54 in/18 = 3 in); Øresund DS15: 1,500/15 = 100 mm; Köhlbrand LR8 760 mm and LR12 1,140 mm, both about 95 mm per gap. If a failed control system lets one gap take twice its share, it needs about 156 to 200 mm, beyond the seal's capacity, and tears. Ratios are derived from public data; the failure case is a teaching assumption. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：依位移、交通量、噪音與維護需求比較型式，製造圖須標示間隙數、每間隙最大開口、控制系統型式與預設方法；出廠前在工廠以千斤頂開合全行程，量測各間隙是否均勻（例如差異不超過數公釐）。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare types by movement, traffic, noise and maintenance needs; shop drawings must show the number of gaps, maximum opening per gap, control-system type and presetting method; before dispatch, cycle the joint through its full range with jacks in the shop and measure gap uniformity, for example within a few millimetres.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

quiz.question: 依「伸縮縫型式與模組式構造」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

steps.instruction: 伸縮縫的力量經錨碇箱、錨筋或錨栓傳到橋面板與梁端：豎向衝擊、上拔與煞車水平力都要靠這些錨碇承受。新建時先在梁端預留凹槽（後澆槽），伸縮縫定位後再澆置高強度或快硬混凝土；更換工程則要鑿除舊後澆混凝土、處理鋼筋，再澆新混凝土。後澆混凝土強度發展決定何時可以開放交通，而強度發展又強烈依賴溫度，所以冬季更換工程的封閉時間往往比夏季長。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「錨碇箱與後澆混凝土」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.instruction: 以同一配比預先建立成熟度—強度曲線，現場在後澆槽埋設溫度感測器即時計算成熟度，並以同條件養護試體確認；錨筋與錨栓在澆置前逐一檢查位置、焊接與保護層，舊混凝土界面清潔、濕潤並檢查無鬆動骨材。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Establish a maturity–strength curve for the same mix in advance, embed temperature sensors in the blockout to compute maturity in real time and confirm with field-cured specimens; check every anchor bar and bolt for position, welding and cover before casting, and make sure the old concrete interface is clean, damp and free of loose aggregate. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：開放交通的條件以成熟度或試體強度表示，而不是以時間表示，並由監造書面放行；施工計畫須依季節預估養護時間並預留應變時段，冬季考慮加溫養護。

steps.failure: 注意干擾：趕在強度未達前開放交通，後澆混凝土在錨筋周圍碎裂，伸縮縫數週內就鬆動並發出撞擊聲；舊混凝土鑿除不徹底，新舊界面脫開，水沿界面滲入梁端，造成鋼筋腐蝕。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

steps.title: 錨碇細部與後澆混凝土養護：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Anchorage details and blockout concrete curing: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「錨碇箱與後澆混凝土」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。

steps.instruction: 趕在強度未達前開放交通，後澆混凝土在錨筋周圍碎裂，伸縮縫數週內就鬆動並發出撞擊聲；舊混凝土鑿除不徹底，新舊界面脫開，水沿界面滲入梁端，造成鋼筋腐蝕。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

quiz.questionEn: When "Anchorage details and blockout concrete curing" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「安裝溫度與預設開口」與「通車條件下的分階段更換」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Installation temperature and preset opening" and "Staged replacement under traffic": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 安裝溫度與預設開口：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Installation temperature and preset opening: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「安裝預設開口」如何影響橋梁伸縮縫安裝與更換的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Installation preset opening” governs force, deformation or durability in “Bridge expansion-joint installation and replacement”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 伸縮縫在工廠以某一開口製造並以臨時夾具固定，安裝時必須依當下的結構溫度與尚未發生的乾縮潛變，調整到正確的預設開口：天氣熱時梁比平均長，開口應較窄；未來還會發生的單向縮短會讓伸縮縫逐漸張開，因此新建混凝土橋在安裝時要再預先收窄一些。預設錯誤的伸縮縫一開始就偏向行程的一端，往後在極端溫度時就會頂死或拉脫。量測要用結構實際溫度，而不是氣溫。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「安裝預設開口」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A joint is manufactured at a set opening and held by temporary clamps; at installation it must be adjusted to the correct preset opening for the current structure temperature and the shrinkage and creep still to come: in hot weather the girder is longer than average so the opening should be narrower, and future one-way shortening will gradually open the joint, so new concrete bridges are set a little narrower still. A joint preset wrongly starts biased towards one end of its range and later jams or pulls apart at extreme temperatures. The measurement must use actual structure temperature, not air temperature. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Installation preset opening” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：4 間隙共 320 mm 的伸縮縫中位開口 160 mm、參考溫度 20°C、伸縮長度 300 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A 4-gap, 320 mm joint has a mid opening of 160 mm at a 20°C reference, with a 300 m expansion length.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「伸縮縫照工廠出貨的開口直接安裝即可。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A joint can be installed at the opening it left the factory with." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「安裝預設開口」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Installation preset opening”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 安裝溫度與預設開口
knowledge.text: 伸縮縫在工廠以某一開口製造並以臨時夾具固定，安裝時必須依當下的結構溫度與尚未發生的乾縮潛變，調整到正確的預設開口：天氣熱時梁比平均長，開口應較窄；未來還會發生的單向縮短會讓伸縮縫逐漸張開，因此新建混凝土橋在安裝時要再預先收窄一些。預設錯誤的伸縮縫一開始就偏向行程的一端，往後在極端溫度時就會頂死或拉脫。
knowledge.textEn: A joint is manufactured at a set opening and held by temporary clamps; at installation it must be adjusted to the correct preset opening for the current structure temperature and the shrinkage and creep still to come: in hot weather the girder is longer than average so the opening should be narrower, and future one-way shortening will gradually open the joint, so new concrete bridges are set a little narrower still. A joint preset wrongly starts biased towards one end of its range and later jams or pulls apart at extreme temperatures.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：伸縮縫照工廠出貨的開口直接安裝即可。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A joint can be installed at the opening it left the factory with. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「安裝溫度與預設開口」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Installation temperature and preset opening" is correct?
options: 伸縮縫照工廠出貨的開口直接安裝即可。
更換伸縮縫只是拆舊換新，與結構安全無關，可由鋪面工班自行處理。
伸縮縫在工廠以某一開口製造並以臨時夾具固定，安裝時必須依當下的結構溫度與尚未發生的乾縮潛變，調整到正確的預設開口：天氣熱時梁比平均長，開口應較窄。
optionsEn: A joint can be installed at the opening it left the factory with.
Replacing a joint is just swapping old for new, unrelated to structural safety, and can be left to the paving crew.
A joint is manufactured at a set opening and held by temporary clamps.

The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 安裝溫度與預設開口：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Installation temperature and preset opening: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「安裝預設開口」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Installation preset opening” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：4 間隙共 320 mm 的伸縮縫中位開口 160 mm、參考溫度 20°C、伸縮長度 300 m。安裝時結構溫度 32°C，梁較中位長 10×10⁻⁶×300,000×12 = 36 mm；未來尚有一半乾縮潛變 0.5×(60 + 64) ≈ 62 mm 會使縫張開。預設開口 = 160 − 36 − 62 ≈ 62 mm。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A 4-gap, 320 mm joint has a mid opening of 160 mm at a 20°C reference, with a 300 m expansion length. At a structure temperature of 32°C the girder is 10×10⁻⁶×300,000×12 = 36 mm longer than at mid; half the shrinkage and creep, 0.5×(60 + 64) ≈ 62 mm, is still to come and will open the joint. Preset opening = 160 − 36 − 62 ≈ 62 mm. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：安裝當天以埋設或表面溫度計量測梁體平均溫度（避免日照直射時段），依預設表計算開口，現場以量規量測各間隙並記錄；夾具拆除前確認預設正確並經監造簽認，拆除後再量一次並記錄當時溫度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: On the day, measure the girder's average temperature with embedded or surface thermometers away from direct sun, calculate the opening from the preset table, gauge and record every gap; before releasing clamps confirm the preset and obtain the supervising engineer's signature, then measure again after release and record the temperature.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 4 間隙共 320 mm 的伸縮縫中位開口 160 mm、參考溫度 20°C、伸縮長度 300 m。安裝時結構溫度 32°C，梁較中位長 10×10⁻⁶×300,000×12 = 36 mm；未來尚有一半乾縮潛變 0.5×(60 + 64) ≈ 62 mm 會使縫張開。預設開口 = 160 − 36 − 62 ≈ 62 mm。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: A 4-gap, 320 mm joint has a mid opening of 160 mm at a 20°C reference, with a 300 m expansion length. At a structure temperature of 32°C the girder is 10×10⁻⁶×300,000×12 = 36 mm longer than at mid; half the shrinkage and creep, 0.5×(60 + 64) ≈ 62 mm, is still to come and will open the joint. Preset opening = 160 − 36 − 62 ≈ 62 mm. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「安裝溫度與預設開口」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

steps.title: 安裝溫度與預設開口：試驗與驗證

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Installation preset opening” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 安裝當天以埋設或表面溫度計量測梁體平均溫度（避免日照直射時段），依預設表計算開口，現場以量規量測各間隙並記錄；夾具拆除前確認預設正確並經監造簽認，拆除後再量一次並記錄當時溫度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: On the day, measure the girder's average temperature with embedded or surface thermometers away from direct sun, calculate the opening from the preset table, gauge and record every gap; before releasing clamps confirm the preset and obtain the supervising engineer's signature, then measure again after release and record the temperature. steps.title: 通車條件下的分階段更換：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Staged replacement under traffic: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「分幅更換與臨時鋪板」如何影響橋梁伸縮縫安裝與更換的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Staged replacement and temporary plates” governs force, deformation or durability in “Bridge expansion-joint installation and replacement”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 伸縮縫更換多半必須在不中斷交通的情況下進行：先封閉部分車道，拆除該幅舊伸縮縫與後澆混凝土，安裝新單元並與相鄰段焊接或栓接，澆置養護後開放，再轉換到另一幅。Øresund 橋 2025 年更換第一座旋轉橫梁伸縮縫時保留了既有錨碇在混凝土中的橫梁箱，只更換伸縮縫單元，並以兩階段三部分施工，先換中段、交通走外側，再換外側兩段；營運單位公告此類大型伸縮縫更換須限制為單向一車道約八週。分段接頭處的焊接與對位品質，決定了日後是否成為疲勞弱點。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「分幅更換與臨時鋪板」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Joint replacement usually has to proceed without stopping traffic: some lanes are closed, the old joint and blockout concrete in that width are removed, the new unit is installed and welded or bolted to the adjacent part, the blockout is cast and cured and the lanes reopened before moving to the next width. When the Øresund Bridge replaced its first swivel-joist joint in 2025, the traverse boxes anchored in the concrete were kept and only the joint unit was exchanged, in two stages and three parts: first the middle part with traffic outside, then the two outer parts; the operator announced that such large joint replacements limit traffic to one lane each way for about eight weeks. The quality of welding and alignment at the splices between parts decides whether they become fatigue weak points. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Staged replacement and temporary plates” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：每一幅的工期 = 拆除 10 h + 安裝 8 h + 分段焊接 6 h + 後澆養護。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Each width takes breakout 10 h + installation 8 h + splice welding 6 h + blockout curing.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「更換伸縮縫只是拆舊換新，與結構安全無關，可由鋪面工班自行處理。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Replacing a joint is just swapping old for new, unrelated to structural safety, and can be left to the paving crew." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「分幅更換與臨時鋪板」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 通車條件下的分階段更換：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Staged replacement under traffic: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「分幅更換與臨時鋪板」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Staged replacement and temporary plates” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：每一幅的工期 = 拆除 10 h + 安裝 8 h + 分段焊接 6 h + 後澆養護。20°C 時養護 30 h，每幅 54 h，兩幅 108 h；10°C 時養護 45 h，每幅 69 h，兩幅 138 h，多出約 28%。若保留錨碇箱只換單元，拆除時間可再縮短。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Each width takes breakout 10 h + installation 8 h + splice welding 6 h + blockout curing. At 20°C curing is 30 h, so 54 h per width and 108 h for two; at 10°C curing is 45 h, so 69 h per width and 138 h for two, about 28% longer. Keeping the anchorage boxes and changing only the unit can shorten breakout further. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：更換前詳細調查舊伸縮縫的錨碇、梁端與支承狀況，決定保留或重建錨碇；交通維持計畫須經主管機關核准，臨時鋪板的承載與固定須經計算；分段接頭的焊接程序事先評定，現場焊後以超音波或磁粉檢測，接頭高差與平整度量測合格才開放。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before replacement, survey the old joint's anchorage, girder ends and bearings in detail to decide whether to keep or rebuild the anchorage; the traffic management plan needs authority approval and temporary plates need calculated capacity and fixing; splice welding procedures are qualified in advance, site welds tested by ultrasonics or magnetic particle, and the joint opens only after step and flatness checks pass.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 出廠疲勞、水密與型式認證：定量估算

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：S–N 曲線 m = 3 時，等效循環 N_t = N_d·(Δσ_d/Δσ_t)³。設計交通在 30 MPa 下相當於 2×10⁸ 次，試驗以 60 MPa 進行，等效次數 2×10⁸×(30/60)³ = 2.5×10⁷ 次，仍需長時間試驗，故常再以更高應力幅或規範規定的試驗程序執行。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With an m = 3 S–N curve, equivalent cycles N_t = N_d·(Δσ_d/Δσ_t)³. steps.instruction: 伸縮縫安裝後的行為是檢驗整個伸縮系統的好指標：若結構能自由伸縮，伸縮縫間隙應隨結構溫度線性變化，斜率等於 α 乘伸縮長度。量測多個季節的間隙與溫度，若斜率明顯偏小，表示某處被約束，例如活動支承卡住、梁端頂到橋台背牆或固定點位置與設計不同；若間隙隨時間單向張開，則反映乾縮潛變的進展。這種量測簡單但資訊豐富，適合列入驗收與定期檢查。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「間隙—溫度量測」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.observation: 如何核對：驗收時量測縫面與鋪面高差、各間隙寬度、排水槽暢通與注水防漏，並在伸縮縫兩側設固定量測點；之後每次檢查記錄間隙與結構溫度，累積資料做迴歸，斜率或截距偏離預測時，安排支承與梁端詳細檢查。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

knowledge.title: 定量模型

Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。

quiz.question: 依「現場驗收與間隙溫度關係量測」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

steps.title: 現場驗收與間隙溫度關係量測：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Site acceptance and gap–temperature measurement: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「間隙—溫度量測」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。

steps.instruction: 驗收時量測縫面與鋪面高差、各間隙寬度、排水槽暢通與注水防漏，並在伸縮縫兩側設固定量測點；之後每次檢查記錄間隙與結構溫度，累積資料做迴歸，斜率或截距偏離預測時，安排支承與梁端詳細檢查。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: As-built records should provide each joint's design gap–temperature line and measuring points, with inspection forms recording temperature and gap in pairs; trends departing from prediction are reported to the structural engineer for assessment.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只看伸縮縫外觀而不量間隙，活動支承因腐蝕卡住多年未被發現，溫度力由墩柱承受而在墩底開裂；間隙長期單向張開未被追蹤，直到止水帶拉脫漏水才察覺。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.title: 現場驗收與間隙溫度關係量測：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Site acceptance and gap–temperature measurement: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「間隙—溫度量測」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Gap–temperature measurement” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只看伸縮縫外觀而不量間隙，活動支承因腐蝕卡住多年未被發現，溫度力由墩柱承受而在墩底開裂；間隙長期單向張開未被追蹤，直到止水帶拉脫漏水才察覺。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Looking only at the joint's appearance without measuring gaps lets a sliding bearing seized by corrosion go unnoticed for years while the piers take the temperature forces and crack at the base; steady one-way opening goes untracked until seals pull out and leak. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這種量測簡單但資訊豐富，適合列入驗收與定期檢查。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The measurement is simple but rich in information and suits acceptance and routine inspection.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「伸縮縫的間隙每天都在變，量測它沒有意義。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Joint gaps change every day, so measuring them is meaningless." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「現場驗收與間隙溫度關係量測」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Site acceptance and gap–temperature measurement" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

伸縮縫漏一點水不影響結構安全，可以等全面更換時再處理。
只看伸縮縫外觀而不量間隙，活動支承因腐蝕卡住多年未被發現，溫度力由墩柱承受而在墩底開裂；間隙長期單向張開未被追蹤，直到止水帶拉脫漏水才察覺。

A little leakage through a joint does not affect structural safety and can wait until full replacement.
Looking only at the joint's appearance without measuring gaps lets a sliding bearing seized by corrosion go unnoticed for years while the piers take the temperature forces and crack at the base.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「漏水、劣化模式與維護」與「更換策略、可更換設計與交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Leakage, deterioration modes and maintenance" and "Replacement strategy, replaceable design and handover": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 漏水、劣化模式與維護：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Leakage, deterioration modes and maintenance: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「止水帶與排水槽」如何影響橋梁伸縮縫安裝與更換的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Seals and drainage trough” governs force, deformation or durability in “Bridge expansion-joint installation and replacement”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 伸縮縫最常見也最昂貴的問題不是伸縮縫本身，而是它漏水：含除冰鹽或海鹽的水穿過破損止水帶，落在支承、墩帽與梁端，造成鋼筋腐蝕、支承鏽蝕與混凝土剝落，修復下部結構的費用常遠高於更換伸縮縫。其他劣化模式包括碎石堆積使間隙無法閉合、止水帶老化撕裂、中梁焊縫疲勞、錨碇鬆動與噪音。維護重點是定期清除碎石、檢查並更換止水帶、確認排水槽通暢，並記錄異常噪音與跳車。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「止水帶與排水槽」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The commonest and costliest joint problem is not the joint itself but leakage: water carrying de-icing or sea salt passes through damaged seals onto bearings, pier caps and girder ends, corroding reinforcement and bearings and spalling concrete, and repairing the substructure often costs far more than replacing the joint. Other deterioration modes include debris packing that stops gaps closing, ageing and tearing seals, fatigue of centre-beam welds, loosened anchorages and noise. Maintenance focuses on regular debris removal, inspecting and renewing seals, keeping drainage troughs clear and logging unusual noise and bumps. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Seals and drainage trough” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：橋面集水面積 16 m × 30 m = 480 m² 流向伸縮縫，降雨強度 50 mm/h 時水量 480×0.05 = 24 m³/h；若止水帶破損使 10% 漏下，每小時約 2.4 m³ 的水直接落在支承與墩帽上，一年多次豪雨即足以使鹽分持續累積。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With a deck catchment of 16 m × 30 m = 480 m² draining towards the joint and 50 mm/h rainfall, the flow is 480×0.05 = 24 m³/h; if a damaged seal lets 10% leak, about 2.4 m³ an hour falls directly on bearings and pier caps, and a few heavy storms a year are enough for salt to keep accumulating.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「伸縮縫漏一點水不影響結構安全，可以等全面更換時再處理。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A little leakage through a joint does not affect structural safety and can wait until full replacement." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.

steps.title: 漏水、劣化模式與維護：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Leakage, deterioration modes and maintenance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「止水帶與排水槽」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Seals and drainage trough” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 定期檢查時由橋下目視墩帽與支承有無水漬、鏽水與白華，由橋面檢查止水帶完整性與碎石堆積；必要時做注水試驗確認漏點，並把結果與上次檢查比較，止水帶破損列為限期修復項目。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: At routine inspections look from below for water stains, rust and efflorescence on pier caps and bearings, and from the deck for seal integrity and debris; where needed, run a water test to locate leaks and compare with the previous inspection, treating damaged seals as a time-limited repair item. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：維護手冊應規定清掃與檢查週期、止水帶更換方法與備品、排水槽清理方式，並把伸縮縫下方的墩帽與支承列為同一檢查單元；止水帶設計宜可從橋面更換，不需拆除整座伸縮縫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The maintenance manual should define cleaning and inspection intervals, seal replacement methods and spares and trough cleaning, treating the pier cap and bearings below the joint as part of the same inspection unit; seals should be replaceable from the deck without removing the whole joint.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：止水帶小破洞多年未修，墩帽頂面長期潮濕含鹽，支承底板鏽蝕失去滑動功能、墩帽保護層剝落露筋，最後必須頂升梁體更換支承並修補墩帽，費用與封閉時間都遠超過更換止水帶。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A small hole in a seal left for years keeps the pier cap wet and salty, the bearing base plate rusts and stops sliding and the cap spalls to expose reinforcement, until the girder must be jacked to replace bearings and repair the cap, at far greater cost and closure time than renewing the seal. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

steps.title: 漏水、劣化模式與維護：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Leakage, deterioration modes and maintenance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「止水帶與排水槽」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Seals and drainage trough” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 止水帶小破洞多年未修，墩帽頂面長期潮濕含鹽，支承底板鏽蝕失去滑動功能、墩帽保護層剝落露筋，最後必須頂升梁體更換支承並修補墩帽，費用與封閉時間都遠超過更換止水帶。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A small hole in a seal left for years keeps the pier cap wet and salty, the bearing base plate rusts and stops sliding and the cap spalls to expose reinforcement, until the girder must be jacked to replace bearings and repair the cap, at far greater cost and closure time than renewing the seal. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：維護重點是定期清除碎石、檢查並更換止水帶、確認排水槽通暢，並記錄異常噪音與跳車。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Maintenance focuses on regular debris removal, inspecting and renewing seals, keeping drainage troughs clear and logging unusual noise and bumps.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「伸縮縫漏一點水不影響結構安全，可以等全面更換時再處理。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A little leakage through a joint does not affect structural safety and can wait until full replacement." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 更換策略、可更換設計與交接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Replacement strategy, replaceable design and handover: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「伸縮縫生命週期紀錄」如何影響橋梁伸縮縫安裝與更換的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Joint life-cycle records” governs force, deformation or durability in “Bridge expansion-joint installation and replacement”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 伸縮縫的使用年限通常遠短於橋梁本身，所以在橋梁一生中會被更換數次；設計時就把更換納入考量，可以大幅縮短未來的封閉時間。例子包括 Øresund 橋保留錨碇在混凝土中的橫梁箱、只更換伸縮縫單元，以及漢堡 Köhlbrand 橋 2014 至 2016 年翻修時採用可快速拆除、不需動到瀝青與混凝土的 QUICK-EX 系統。交接文件應記錄每一座伸縮縫的型式、預設、安裝溫度、試驗報告與檢查歷程，讓下一次更換可以事先規劃。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「伸縮縫生命週期紀錄」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Joints usually last far less than the bridge, so they are replaced several times in its life, and designing for replacement greatly shortens future closures. Examples include the Øresund Bridge keeping the traverse boxes anchored in concrete and replacing only the joint unit, and Hamburg's Köhlbrand Bridge using the QUICK-EX system in its 2014–2016 rehabilitation so joints can be removed quickly without disturbing asphalt or concrete. Handover documents should record each joint's type, preset, installation temperature, test reports and inspection history so the next replacement can be planned in advance. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Joint life-cycle records” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：橋梁設計年限 100 年、伸縮縫壽命 25 年：一生中需更換 100/25 − 1 = 3 次。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With a 100-year bridge and a 25-year joint life, 100/25 − 1 = 3 replacements are needed.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「伸縮縫壞了再換即可，設計時不必考慮更換方式。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

quiz.question: 關於「更換策略、可更換設計與交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

Joints usually last far less than the bridge, so they are replaced several times in its life, and designing for replacement greatly shortens future closures.
Joint movement only needs to be calculated from temperature change.
quiz.explanation: 伸縮縫的使用年限通常遠短於橋梁本身，所以在橋梁一生中會被更換數次；設計時就把更換納入考量，可以大幅縮短未來的封閉時間。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Joints usually last far less than the bridge, so they are replaced several times in its life, and designing for replacement greatly shortens future closures. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 更換策略、可更換設計與交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Replacement strategy, replaceable design and handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「伸縮縫生命週期紀錄」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Joint life-cycle records” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：橋梁設計年限 100 年、伸縮縫壽命 25 年：一生中需更換 100/25 − 1 = 3 次。全橋 8 座伸縮縫，若每座需鑿除錨碇重建、封閉 6 天，總計 3×8×6 = 144 天；若保留錨碇只換單元、每座 3.5 天，總計 84 天，減少約 42%。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With a 100-year bridge and a 25-year joint life, 100/25 − 1 = 3 replacements are needed. For 8 joints, rebuilding the anchorage at 6 closure days each totals 3×8×6 = 144 days; keeping the anchorage and changing only the unit at 3.5 days each totals 84 days, about 42% less. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：交接前清點每一座伸縮縫的資料：製造圖、型式與疲勞試驗報告、出廠檢驗、預設與安裝溫度紀錄、驗收量測、備品清單與更換程序，並確認營運單位已建立間隙—溫度與漏水檢查的基準資料。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before handover, check each joint's records: shop drawings, type and fatigue test reports, factory inspection, preset and installation-temperature records, acceptance measurements, spare-parts list and replacement procedure, and confirm the owner has baselines for gap–temperature and leakage inspections.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: With a 100-year bridge and a 25-year joint life, 100/25 − 1 = 3 replacements are needed. For 8 joints, rebuilding the anchorage at 6 closure days each totals 3×8×6 = 144 days; keeping the anchorage and changing only the unit at 3.5 days each totals 84 days, about 42% less. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「更換策略、可更換設計與交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Replacement strategy, replaceable design and handover", which statement holds?
options: 模組式伸縮縫的間隙會自然平均開合，不需要控制系統。
伸縮縫照工廠出貨的開口直接安裝即可。
橋梁設計年限 100 年、伸縮縫壽命 25 年：一生中需更換 100/25 − 1 = 3 次。
optionsEn: Modular joint gaps open evenly by themselves without a control system.
A joint can be installed at the opening it left the factory with.
With a 100-year bridge and a 25-year joint life, 100/25 − 1 = 3 replacements are needed.
quiz.explanation: 橋梁設計年限 100 年、伸縮縫壽命 25 年：一生中需更換 100/25 − 1 = 3 次。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With a 100-year bridge and a 25-year joint life, 100/25 − 1 = 3 replacements are needed. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 更換策略、可更換設計與交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Replacement strategy, replaceable design and handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「伸縮縫生命週期紀錄」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Joint life-cycle records” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 交接前清點每一座伸縮縫的資料：製造圖、型式與疲勞試驗報告、出廠檢驗、預設與安裝溫度紀錄、驗收量測、備品清單與更換程序，並確認營運單位已建立間隙—溫度與漏水檢查的基準資料。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before handover, check each joint's records: shop drawings, type and fatigue test reports, factory inspection, preset and installation-temperature records, acceptance measurements, spare-parts list and replacement procedure, and confirm the owner has baselines for gap–temperature and leakage inspections. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：設計規格應要求伸縮縫可在部分車道封閉下分幅更換、錨碇可保留、止水帶可從橋面更換；交接文件包含上述全部紀錄與更換程序，並由營運單位指定專人管理伸縮縫資產資料。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Design specifications should require joints to be replaceable width by width under partial lane closures, with retainable anchorages and seals renewable from the deck; handover includes all the records above and the replacement procedure, and the owner assigns a person to manage joint asset data.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：交接資料缺漏，十多年後更換伸縮縫時不知道原設計位移、錨碇細部與預設方法，只能保守地全部鑿除重建，封閉時間與成本倍增；若新伸縮縫型式與舊錨碇不相容，還需修改梁端結構。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: With incomplete handover records, a replacement a decade or two later cannot know the original design movements, anchorage details or presetting method, so everything is conservatively broken out and rebuilt, multiplying closure time and cost; a new joint incompatible with the old anchorage may even require changes to the girder ends. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 交接前清點每一座伸縮縫的資料：製造圖、型式與疲勞試驗報告、出廠檢驗、預設與安裝溫度紀錄、驗收量測、備品清單與更換程序，並確認營運單位已建立間隙—溫度與漏水檢查的基準資料。
knowledge.textEn: Before handover, check each joint's records: shop drawings, type and fatigue test reports, factory inspection, preset and installation-temperature records, acceptance measurements, spare-parts list and replacement procedure, and confirm the owner has baselines for gap–temperature and leakage inspections.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 設計規格應要求伸縮縫可在部分車道封閉下分幅更換、錨碇可保留、止水帶可從橋面更換；交接文件包含上述全部紀錄與更換程序，並由營運單位指定專人管理伸縮縫資產資料。
knowledge.textEn: Design specifications should require joints to be replaceable width by width under partial lane closures, with retainable anchorages and seals renewable from the deck; handover includes all the records above and the replacement procedure, and the owner assigns a person to manage joint asset data.

quiz.question: 要驗證「更換策略、可更換設計與交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Replacement strategy, replaceable design and handover"?
options: 交接前清點每一座伸縮縫的資料：製造圖、型式與疲勞試驗報告、出廠檢驗、預設與安裝溫度紀錄、驗收量測、備品清單與更換程序，並確認營運單位已建立間隙—溫度與漏水檢查的基準資料。

Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.

quiz.explanationEn: Before handover, check each joint's records: shop drawings, type and fatigue test reports, factory inspection, preset and installation-temperature records, acceptance measurements, spare-parts list and replacement procedure, and confirm the owner has baselines for gap–temperature and leakage inspections. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 更換策略、可更換設計與交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Replacement strategy, replaceable design and handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「伸縮縫生命週期紀錄」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Joint life-cycle records” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 交接資料缺漏，十多年後更換伸縮縫時不知道原設計位移、錨碇細部與預設方法，只能保守地全部鑿除重建，封閉時間與成本倍增；若新伸縮縫型式與舊錨碇不相容，還需修改梁端結構。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: With incomplete handover records, a replacement a decade or two later cannot know the original design movements, anchorage details or presetting method, so everything is conservatively broken out and rebuilt, multiplying closure time and cost; a new joint incompatible with the old anchorage may even require changes to the girder ends. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：交接文件應記錄每一座伸縮縫的型式、預設、安裝溫度、試驗報告與檢查歷程，讓下一次更換可以事先規劃。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Handover documents should record each joint's type, preset, installation temperature, test reports and inspection history so the next replacement can be planned in advance.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「伸縮縫壞了再換即可，設計時不必考慮更換方式。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A joint can simply be replaced when it fails; its replacement need not be considered in design." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.
